features.text: PDAC APPROVED L1850: Medicare-verified Swedish-style orthosis for hyperextension and genu recurvatum management.
AIR BLADDER CONTROL SYSTEM: Adjustable pneumatic bladder gently resists knee hyperextension for smoother gait.
CUSTOMIZED STABILITY: Dual adjustable straps and precision air pressure provide individualized comfort and control.
LIGHTWEIGHT 10-INCH FRAME: Streamlined design improves comfort while maintaining powerful knee stabilization.
EASY TO APPLY: Quick on/off design with trimmable straps ensures secure fit and convenience.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
